instruction_interval_upgrade.upper_bound_rule: OUT_OF_BOUND is upgraded only when the C-proved scaled byte-offset max plus TABLE, displacement, and width is <= the window start; all PS1 2 MiB RAM mirrors in direct/KSEG0/KSEG1 spellings must also be excluded; the prior idx_bound/loop convention is never consumed

second_opinion.scope: every image carrying an unresolved site, resident and overlay. An overlay run sees only that overlay, so its calls into the resident executable stay unresolved and its functions get no argument seeding from resident callers -- weaker than the resident run, never less sound, because an unseeded register is TOP and TOP yields no region and therefore no exclusion.
second_opinion.soundness: EXCLUDED_NEGATIVE_INDEX and EXCLUDED_OUT_OF_BOUND rely on the non-negative, loop-bound-checked array-index convention -- an assumption about how the code was written, not a fact the instructions state. Kept out of bounded_by_proof for that reason. EXCLUDED_ALIGNMENT is unconditional given the disassembled base shape and is invariant to anchor choice, which is why it is the only tier permitted on an unanchored region -- re-checked here per site, fail-closed.
